text_block_list.text:
The final day of summer camp. After working
hard in her own way, Daitaku Helios—

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
“—Trai-pi!
Let's launch it, yeah!!”
(Whistleeee... BOOM!)

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Oooh!
So colorful!

We were enjoying fireworks in the middle of the day.
……In reality, we're just launching ones
that shoot out colored smoke, though.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: "I mean, I was just spitballing, but daytime fireworks are actually a real thing!"
choice_data_list: I looked it up and found out myself.
I looked it up and found out too.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Wait, that thing!
The thing you look stuff up with!"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
If it were me, I'd just vibe with it for now,
y'know? Go totally original with it.
choice_data_list: That's what's so amazing about it.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Hm? Where??
choice_data_list: There's more than one right answer for Helios

text_block_list.text:
If it were me, when faced with the unknown,
I'd first search for the correct answer. But
she finds her own answer first.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Maybe??
Not like I know!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Having everything decided from the start
would be totally boring!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"I decide what's fun for me!
That's all there is to it☆"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Played at the beach, did fireworks too!
Summer is perfect! All that's left is—
choice_data_list: Just gotta crush it at the Mile CS!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Totally!!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: O・jo・u☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why're you still in your track suit? Isn't the bus almost here?

text_block_list.name: Daiichi Ruby
text_block_list.text:
I am aware.
I am in a hurry, so please excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Aaah!!
Salt~!!
choice_data_list: I wonder if she was training till the last second

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
See? I end up looking kind of unladylike.
Even though getting ready turns into a total scramble.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Thanks to that, we got to talk, so I'm super happy, though!

From what I've seen so far, to be completely frank,
it doesn't look like Daiichi Ruby is paying any mind to you at all...
choice_data_list: Why are you so curious about Ruby?
Why are you so curious about Ruby?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Gut feeling?
choice_data_list: To get that far on feeling alone...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I've been tellin' ya!
It's the most important thing to me☆

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"Maybe it's that?
Like, wanting to see them smile?"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Totally! Like, Ojou never bursts out laughing,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
I just wanna see it once...
her laughing with all her heart!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
At that time, ya know...
How do I put it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Ojo and I... we're definitely gonna be
besties for the very first time.

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
"...Probably.
Yeah, something like that?"
choice_data_list: I hope you'll smile for me someday.
It'd be nice if you smiled for me someday, huh?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Right~☆

And so, the curtain fell
on our second summer training camp.
